name: GRANTFINDER AGENT
description: A UK funding-discovery agent that matches organisations and projects to grant opportunities and returns structured research results, evidence requirements and reviewable application plans. This static preview demonstrates the human-facing workflow and agent result shape; it does not expose a remote A2A transport.

skills.name: Find grants
skills.description: Identify relevant UK funding opportunities from a seeded research set.
examples: Find funding for a Dorset community wellbeing project.

skills.name: Match grants to an organisation profile
skills.description: Compare an organisation profile with published opportunity criteria and return a fit score with reasoning.
examples: Match these grants to a CIC supporting adults facing isolation.

skills.name: Compare opportunities
skills.description: Return a structured comparison of funding amount, deadline, geography, theme and evidence requirements.
examples: Compare the strongest matches and show what evidence is missing.

skills.name: Prepare an application plan
skills.description: Create a reviewable deadline and evidence plan for a selected opportunity.
examples: Prepare the evidence and deadline plan for the best match.

skills.name: Check eligibility criteria
skills.description: Surface geography, organisation, theme and amount checks against the published criteria represented in the research set.
examples: Show which eligibility criteria the Dorset CIC currently meets.

skills.name: List required evidence
skills.description: Return the evidence items needed for a selected opportunity and identify the open human-review item.
examples: List the evidence still needed for the Coastal Communities Fund.

skills.name: Prepare a deadline schedule
skills.description: Create a reviewable sequence of eligibility, evidence, drafting and submission milestones for a selected opportunity.
examples: Prepare a deadline schedule for the September submission.

skills.name: Draft from evidence
skills.description: Create a clearly labelled draft answer from the seeded organisation profile and evidence references for human review.
examples: Draft an answer from the impact report and participant survey.

skills.name: Request human review
skills.description: Mark research or draft output as requiring human review before eligibility decisions or submission.
examples: Return the shortlist for human review without submitting anything.

metadata.matchScoreMeaning: fit to published criteria, not a predicted probability of receiving funding
